stacked-sacks.context: Side view of three filled sacks stacked in a pyramid on a pallet line. Marks bagged goods such as cement, flour, feed and fertiliser on pallets, and sack storage in stock lists.

shrink-hood.context: Pallet load under a tight plastic hood with a heat gun blowing on its side. Used for pallet protection options, packaging specifications and hooding lines in packing plants.

pallet-cover.context: Pallet load under a quilted insulated cover with a zip down one side. Shows insulated or protective covers for temperature sensitive pallets in cold chain shipping and air freight options.

banded-bundle.context: Bundle of boards tied with two metal straps. Marks strapped bundles of timber, pipe or sheet goods in freight listings and packing instructions.

strapping-tensioner.context: Hand tensioning tool with two lever handles gripping a strap around a box. Stands for strapping and banding tools in packing supplies, workshop inventories and shipping prep guides.

strapping-coil.context: Coil of flat strap on a core with a loose end lying along the bottom. Used for strapping stock, packing supplies and consumables in warehouse inventory and shop catalogues.

carton-sealer.context: Box passing under a machine frame whose tape head seals the top seam. Represents automatic case sealing and taping stations on packaging lines and in equipment lists.

tilt-indicator.context: Sticker with a triangular channel and a small ball resting in one arm. Marks cargo fitted with tilt indicators for hand-off checks, damage claims and handling instructions.

shock-indicator.context: Small label with a capsule window holding a coloured bar that shows impact. Marks cargo fitted with impact indicators and appears in damage claim, handling and insurance screens.

do-not-stack.context: Box with a second box above it struck through by a diagonal line. Used as the handling mark that forbids placing other cartons on top, in packing guides and labelling settings.

un-number-panel.context: Placard split into two rows each showing four digits. Stands for the hazard identification panel on dangerous goods vehicles and tanks, and UN number lookups.

limited-quantity-mark.context: Diamond outline with solid top and bottom triangles and an empty middle band. Used for the mark on packages carrying dangerous goods in limited quantities, in shipping and compliance tools.

lithium-battery-label.context: Square label with a battery carrying a flame inside. Used for labels on shipments containing lithium cells, in courier settings and dangerous goods checks.

marine-pollutant-mark.context: Diamond placard with a dead fish lying under bare branches. Used for packages that must not contaminate waters, in sea freight dangerous goods settings and labelling guides.

magnetized-material-label.context: Square label with a horseshoe magnet and field arcs beside it. Used for air cargo labels on strongly magnetic goods that can disturb aircraft compasses.

fragile-tape.context: Roll of tape with a strip unrolled beneath it printed with repeating glass bowls. Stands for printed warning tape and fragile packing supplies in shops and warehouse consumables lists.

air-waybill.context: Document sheet with a small plane at the top and a barcode strip along the bottom. Stands for the air cargo consignment document in shipment records, booking screens and customs paperwork.

certificate-of-origin.context: Landscape certificate with a globe and a round seal with two ribbons. Stands for the export document that states where goods were made, used in customs and trade compliance tools.

delivery-note.context: Sheet with a small truck at the top, an item line and a signature squiggle. Stands for the signed delivery document in order histories, proof of delivery lists and driver apps.

dangerous-goods-declaration.context: Document with a diamond hazard placard at the top right and form lines. Stands for the shipper's signed dangerous goods form in booking, compliance and air freight workflows.

customs-tariff.context: Parcel box beside a hanging tag showing a percent sign. Stands for customs duty rates, import duty and tax lines on cross-border checkout and shipping screens.

bonded-warehouse.context: Warehouse building with a padlock on its front. Stands for customs controlled storage where duties are held until goods are released, in trade and logistics tools.

nothing-to-declare.context: Hanging airport sign showing an arrow toward an empty suitcase outline. Used for the customs exit route for travellers with nothing to declare, in airport wayfinding and travel apps.

sniffer-dog.context: Dog with its nose down beside a suitcase and sniff lines curling up. Stands for detection dog checks at borders, airports and freight terminals, in security and inspection contexts.

parcel-pickup-point.context: Map pin holding a small parcel box. Marks locations where customers collect parcels, in delivery apps, checkouts and store locators.

parcel-drop-box.context: Freestanding metal box with a drop hatch on its front and a keyhole below. Stands for secure parcel drop-off boxes and return lockers, in store locators and return flows.

delivery-photo.context: Smartphone screen with corner brackets framing a box resting on a mat. Stands for the photo a courier takes as proof that a parcel was left at the door, in tracking and delivery apps.

shipment-timeline.context: Horizontal line with four stops, three filled and the last empty, and a truck above the third. Shows tracking progress through delivery stages with a truck at the current stop, in order tracking pages.

delivery-date.context: Calendar page with a parcel box in the middle of the grid. Marks the expected arrival day of an order, in checkout, tracking and scheduling screens.

contactless-delivery.context: Parcel on the ground, a person stepping back and a two-headed distance arrow between. Stands for drop-at-the-door delivery with no hand over, in food and parcel delivery settings.

restocking.context: Box on the floor with a curved arrow rising to a box on a shelf plank. Stands for refilling shelves or stock levels, in inventory, retail operations and replenishment tools.

overstock.context: Shelf row of crowded boxes with an extra box tipping over the edge on top. Flags excess inventory and overfull shelves, in inventory reports and warehouse capacity alerts.

fifo-lane.context: Lane with two boxes, an arrow entering at the back and an arrow leaving at the front. Stands for first in, first out stock rotation in flow racks and queue lanes, in inventory settings.

stock-transfer.context: Two small warehouses with a box and an arrow passing between them. Stands for moving inventory between two sites, in inventory and warehouse management screens.

kanban-bin.context: Two parts bins side by side, one with a card standing out of its label slot. Stands for bin based replenishment signals in lean supply systems and parts storage.

dropshipping.context: Factory and house joined by a dashed arrow carrying a box above a small shop. Stands for selling goods that ship straight from the supplier to the customer, in ecommerce setup screens.

shipment-consolidation.context: Three small boxes with lines converging into one large box. Stands for combining several small shipments into one larger load, in freight and order tools.

load-plan.context: Top view of a trailer outline packed with box rectangles of different sizes. Stands for planning how cargo is arranged inside a trailer, in transport planning and loading software.

goods-receiving.context: Open dock door with a box on an arrow heading in and a tick above the doorway. Stands for inbound dock checks when deliveries arrive, in warehouse and purchasing software.

pallet-put-away.context: Forklift raising a loaded pallet on its mast toward a tall rack with an empty slot. Stands for moving received pallets into racking locations, in warehouse task lists.

order-picking.context: Shelf of four slots with a box leaving one on an arrow into a tote below. Stands for picking items from shelf slots into a tote, in fulfilment and warehouse software.

packing-station.context: Workbench with a tape roll and an open box with its flaps up on top. Stands for the bench where picked orders are boxed and sealed, in fulfilment workflows.

cross-docking.context: Warehouse outline with a straight arrow running through it from side to side. Stands for moving goods straight from inbound to outbound docks without storing them, in logistics planning.

cold-storage-warehouse.context: Warehouse building with a large snowflake on its front. Stands for refrigerated or frozen storage buildings, in cold chain and facility listings.

walk-in-freezer.context: Heavy insulated door with a large latch lever and a thermometer beside it. Stands for walk-in cold rooms and their temperature panels, in kitchen, store and warehouse facility settings.

lashing-bar.context: Long rod with an eye at the top and a turnbuckle in the middle braced diagonally in a container corner. Stands for container lashing rods and sea fastening gear, in port, ship and stowage tools.

high-loader.context: Scissor lift vehicle raising a cargo deck with a box level with an aircraft door. Stands for ground handling lifts that load cargo containers into aircraft, in airport operations tools.

piggyback-railcar.context: Flat railcar carrying a truck trailer whose wheels rest on the deck. Stands for carrying road trailers on trains, in intermodal and rail freight planning.

centerbeam-flatcar.context: Flat railcar with a tall central lattice wall and lumber bundles stacked on both sides. Stands for railcars built for lumber and building materials, in rail freight and supply chain tools.

hook-lift-truck.context: Truck with a bent hook arm pulling an open roll-off bin onto its frame. Stands for roll-off bin trucks and skip lorries, in waste hauling and site services.

glass-transport-truck.context: Truck with an A-frame rack on its bed holding large glass panes leaning on both sides. Stands for trucks that carry large glass panes on A-frame racks, in glazing and delivery services.

modular-transporter.context: Long flat platform on many small wheels carrying a large cylindrical tank. Stands for multi-axle platform transporters that move very heavy or oversize loads, in heavy haulage tools.

chain-binder.context: Lever load binder with a long handle and two hooks pulling chain links together. Stands for lever binders that tension chains on flatbed loads, in load securing and trucking guides.

load-bar.context: Telescoping bar with rubber end pads wedged across a trailer in front of two boxes. Stands for telescoping bars that brace cargo inside a trailer, in load securing guides.

dunnage-bag.context: Inflated air bag with a valve squeezed between two stacks of boxes. Stands for inflatable void fill that stops cargo shifting, in packing and container loading instructions.

tie-down-ring.context: Folding D-shaped ring hinged to a square floor plate with four bolt holes. Stands for floor mounted lashing points in trailers and vehicles, in load securing and fleet specs.

rack-guard.context: Steel foot guard around a rack upright with diagonal hazard stripes. Stands for protective guards at the foot of pallet rack uprights, in warehouse safety and facility checks.

clamp-forklift.context: Forklift with two large flat pads in place of forks squeezing a stack of boxes. Stands for forklifts with clamp attachments for appliances, cartons and rolls, in equipment and fleet lists.

forklift-safety-cage.context: Mesh work cage with a grid of wire on forks raised part way up a mast. Stands for work cages lifted by forklift so staff can reach high shelves, in safety rules and equipment lists.

mobile-racking.context: Row of tall shelving units on floor rails, the end one with a three-spoke crank wheel. Stands for rolling shelving blocks on floor rails, in archive, cold room and storage planning.

panel-cart.context: Wheeled A-frame cart carrying large flat sheets leaning on one side. Stands for carts that move large boards, plywood or glass, in building supply and workshop tools.

machine-skates.context: Pair of low roller skates with swivel plates carrying a heavy machine block. Stands for roller skates used to shift heavy machinery, in rigging, moving and plant relocation.

checkweigher.context: Short conveyor with a box on a weighing section and a display on a post above. Stands for inline scales that check parcel weight on a conveyor, in packing lines and quality control.

pocket-sorter.context: Overhead rail with a row of hanging pouch bags, two of them holding small parcels. Stands for overhead sorters that carry items in hanging pouches, in fulfilment and garment logistics.

pick-path.context: Top view of three shelf bars with a dotted route snaking down one aisle and up the next. Stands for routed walking paths through warehouse aisles, in picking route and layout tools.

inventory-drone.context: Small quadcopter beside a tall pallet rack with scan lines reaching a box label. Stands for drones that scan pallet rack labels to count stock, in inventory automation tools.

pallet-label.context: Tall label with a text line above three stacked barcodes of uneven bars. Stands for the tall logistics label with barcodes on a pallet, in labelling and receiving settings.

open-side-container.context: Shipping container with its long side opened on raised and lowered hinged panels, boxes inside. Stands for containers that open along the full long side for easy loading, in container type pickers.

shelf-ready-tray.context: Cardboard tray with a zigzag torn front showing a row of tall cans standing inside. Stands for retail trays that tear open to display product on shelf, in packaging and merchandising specs.

vacuum-tube-lifter.context: Flexible hose hanging from an overhead arm with a suction pad and handle holding a box. Stands for vacuum assist lifters that let one worker move boxes and sacks, in ergonomic handling tools.

c-hook.context: C shaped lifting hook on a crane cable with a steel coil sitting on its lower arm. Stands for coil lifting hooks on overhead cranes, in steel mill and warehouse handling tools.

lever-hoist.context: Compact hoist with a long lever handle, a ring at the top and a chain running to a ring below. Stands for hand operated ratchet hoists used in rigging and maintenance, in tools and lifting gear lists.

moving-blanket.context: Thick quilted pad with diamond stitching lying over the top of a dresser. Stands for padded covers that protect furniture during removals, in moving services and packing supplies.

miscellaneous-hazard-label.context: Diamond placard with vertical stripes in its top half and the number nine below. Stands for the class 9 hazard label on miscellaneous dangerous goods such as batteries and dry ice.

keep-away-from-sunlight.context: Box under a small sun whose rays fall toward it, the handling mark for protect from heat. Used for the handling mark that asks for cargo to be kept out of sun and heat, in packing and labelling guides.

temperature-limits.context: Thermometer with two short limit bars marking an upper and a lower temperature. Used for the handling mark that sets the allowed temperature range for cargo, in cold chain guides.

phytosanitary-certificate.context: Certificate sheet with a leaf at the top and a round inspection stamp below. Stands for plant health export paperwork, in agricultural trade and customs tools.

neighbor-delivery.context: Two small houses with a box riding a curved arrow from one to the other. Stands for leaving a parcel with a neighbour when nobody is home, in delivery options and notices.

white-glove-delivery.context: Armchair carried by two gloved hands with cuffs at the bottom corners. Stands for premium delivery where the carrier carries furniture inside and sets it up, in checkout options.

backorder.context: Parcel box beside a small hourglass with sand running to the lower half. Flags items that are out of stock but on order, in product pages, carts and order statuses.
